passages.text: Therefore, since we have been justified through faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ, through whom we have gained access by faith into this grace in which we stand. And we rejoice in the hope of the glory of God.
passages.sermon:
God justifies us through faith.
We now have peace with God.
Jesus Christ is our Lord.
God gives us peace through Jesus Christ.
We believe in Jesus Christ.
Through Jesus Christ, we have access to God's grace.
We stand in this grace by faith.
We rejoice because we hope for God's glory.
passages.original: Δικαιωθέντες οὖν ἐκ πίστεως εἰρήνην ἔχομεν πρὸς τὸν Θεὸν διὰ τοῦ Κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ δι’ οὗ καὶ τὴν προσαγωγὴν ἐσχήκαμεν τῇ πίστει εἰς τὴν χάριν ταύτην ἐν ᾗ ἑστήκαμεν καὶ καυχώμεθα ἐπ’ ἐλπίδι τῆς δόξης τοῦ Θεοῦ

passages.text: Not only that, but we also rejoice in our sufferings, because we know that suffering produces perseverance; perseverance, character; and character, hope.
passages.sermon:
We are Christians who have been justified by faith in Jesus Christ.
We rejoice in our sufferings.
We know that suffering produces perseverance.
Perseverance produces character.
Character produces hope.
passages.original: Οὐ μόνον δέ ἀλλὰ καὶ καυχώμεθα ἐν ταῖς θλίψεσιν εἰδότες ὅτι ἡ θλῖψις ὑπομονὴν κατεργάζεται ἡ δὲ ὑπομονὴ δοκιμήν ἡ δὲ δοκιμὴ ἐλπίδα

passages.text: And hope does not disappoint us, because God has poured out His love into our hearts through the Holy Spirit, whom He has given us.
passages.sermon:
God gives us His love.
God pours His love into our hearts.
God does this through the Holy Spirit.
God has given the Holy Spirit to us.
Hope does not disappoint us.
God’s love in our hearts gives us this hope.
passages.original: ἡ δὲ ἐλπὶς οὐ καταισχύνει ὅτι ἡ ἀγάπη τοῦ Θεοῦ ἐκκέχυται ἐν ταῖς καρδίαις ἡμῶν διὰ Πνεύματος Ἁγίου τοῦ δοθέντος ἡμῖν

passages.text: For at just the right time, while we were still powerless, Christ died for the ungodly.
passages.sermon:
Christ is the Son of God.
We were powerless.
We could not save ourselves.
At the right time, Christ died.
He died for the ungodly.
passages.original: Ἔτι γὰρ Χριστὸς ὄντων ἡμῶν ἀσθενῶν ἔτι κατὰ καιρὸν ὑπὲρ ἀσεβῶν ἀπέθανεν

passages.text: Very rarely will anyone die for a righteous man, though for a good man someone might possibly dare to die.
passages.sermon:
People almost never die for a righteous man.
A righteous man does what is right.
Sometimes, for a good man, someone might dare to die.
A good man shows kindness and goodness.
It is very rare for anyone to die for another person, even if that person is righteous or good.
passages.original: μόλις γὰρ ὑπὲρ δικαίου τις ἀποθανεῖται ὑπὲρ γὰρ τοῦ ἀγαθοῦ τάχα τις καὶ τολμᾷ ἀποθανεῖν

passages.text: But God proves His love for us in this: While we were still sinners, Christ died for us.
passages.sermon: God shows His love for us.\r\nWe were still sinners.\r\nChrist died for us.
passages.original: συνίστησιν δὲ τὴν ἑαυτοῦ ἀγάπην εἰς ἡμᾶς ὁ Θεὸς ὅτι ἔτι ἁμαρτωλῶν ὄντων ἡμῶν Χριστὸς ὑπὲρ ἡμῶν ἀπέθανεν

passages.text: Therefore, since we have now been justified by His blood, how much more shall we be saved from wrath through Him!
passages.sermon:
God sent Jesus Christ, His Son.
Jesus Christ died for us.
His blood justifies us now.
We are declared righteous because of His blood.
Because we are justified, we will be saved from God’s wrath.
We will be saved through Jesus Christ.
passages.original: Πολλῷ οὖν μᾶλλον δικαιωθέντες νῦν ἐν τῷ αἵματι αὐτοῦ σωθησόμεθα δι’ αὐτοῦ ἀπὸ τῆς ὀργῆς

passages.text: For if, when we were enemies of God, we were reconciled to Him through the death of His Son, how much more, having been reconciled, shall we be saved through His life!
passages.sermon:
God acted when we were His enemies.
We were separated from God.
God reconciled us to Himself.
He did this through the death of His Son, Jesus Christ.
Now we are reconciled to God.
We are no longer His enemies.
Because we are reconciled, we will be saved.
We will be saved through the life of Jesus Christ.
passages.original: εἰ γὰρ ἐχθροὶ ὄντες κατηλλάγημεν τῷ Θεῷ διὰ τοῦ θανάτου τοῦ Υἱοῦ αὐτοῦ πολλῷ μᾶλλον καταλλαγέντες σωθησόμεθα ἐν τῇ ζωῇ αὐτοῦ

passages.text: Not only that, but we also rejoice in God through our Lord Jesus Christ, through whom we have now received reconciliation.
passages.sermon:
We rejoice in God.
We do this through our Lord Jesus Christ.
Through Jesus Christ, we have now received reconciliation.
We do not only receive reconciliation.
We also rejoice in God because of Jesus Christ.
passages.original: οὐ μόνον δέ ἀλλὰ καὶ καυχώμενοι ἐν τῷ Θεῷ διὰ τοῦ Κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ δι’ οὗ νῦν τὴν καταλλαγὴν ἐλάβομεν

passages.text: Therefore, just as sin entered the world through one man, and death through sin, so also death was passed on to all men, because all sinned.
passages.sermon:
Adam was the first man.
Sin entered the world through Adam.
Death came into the world because of sin.
Death spread to all people.
All people sinned.
passages.original: Διὰ τοῦτο ὥσπερ δι’ ἑνὸς ἀνθρώπου ἡ ἁμαρτία εἰς τὸν κόσμον εἰσῆλθεν καὶ διὰ τῆς ἁμαρτίας ὁ θάνατος καὶ οὕτως εἰς πάντας ἀνθρώπους ὁ θάνατος διῆλθεν ἐφ’ ᾧ πάντες ἥμαρτον

passages.text: For sin was in the world before the law was given; but sin is not taken into account when there is no law.
passages.sermon: Sin existed in the world before God gave the law.\r\nPeople sinned even before the law came.\r\nGod does not count sin where there is no law.
passages.original: ἄχρι γὰρ νόμου ἁμαρτία ἦν ἐν κόσμῳ ἁμαρτία δὲ οὐκ ἐλλογεῖται μὴ ὄντος νόμου

passages.text: Nevertheless, death reigned from Adam until Moses, even over those who did not sin in the way that Adam transgressed. He is a pattern of the One to come.
passages.sermon:
Adam was the first man.
Moses was a leader and lawgiver.
Death ruled over people from Adam to Moses.
Death ruled even over people who did not sin like Adam did.
Adam broke a command from God.
Some people did not break a command in the same way.
Death still ruled over them.
Adam is a pattern of the One who was to come.
passages.original: ἀλλὰ ἐβασίλευσεν ὁ θάνατος ἀπὸ Ἀδὰμ μέχρι Μωϋσέως καὶ ἐπὶ τοὺς μὴ ἁμαρτήσαντας ἐπὶ τῷ ὁμοιώματι τῆς παραβάσεως Ἀδάμ ὅς ἐστιν τύπος τοῦ μέλλοντος

passages.text: But the gift is not like the trespass. For if the many died by the trespass of the one man, how much more did God’s grace and the gift that came by the grace of the one man, Jesus Christ, abound to the many!
passages.sermon:
Adam was the first man.
Adam sinned.
His sin was a trespass.
Many people died because of Adam’s one trespass.
Jesus Christ is one man.
God gave a gift through Jesus Christ.
This gift is not like Adam’s trespass.
God’s grace came through Jesus Christ.
God’s gift came by grace through Jesus Christ.
God’s grace and gift overflowed to many people.
God’s grace is much greater than the result of Adam’s trespass.
passages.original: Ἀλλ’ οὐχ ὡς τὸ παράπτωμα οὕτως καὶ τὸ χάρισμα εἰ γὰρ τῷ τοῦ ἑνὸς παραπτώματι οἱ πολλοὶ ἀπέθανον πολλῷ μᾶλλον ἡ χάρις τοῦ Θεοῦ καὶ ἡ δωρεὰ ἐν χάριτι τῇ τοῦ ἑνὸς ἀνθρώπου Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ εἰς τοὺς πολλοὺς ἐπερίσσευσεν

passages.text: Again, the gift is not like the result of the one man’s sin: The judgment that followed one sin brought condemnation, but the gift that followed many trespasses brought justification.
passages.sermon:
The gift is not like the result of one man's sin.
One man sinned.
Judgment came because of that one sin.
That judgment brought condemnation.
But the gift is different.
Many people committed many sins.
The gift came after those many sins.
The gift brought justification.
passages.original: καὶ οὐχ ὡς δι’ ἑνὸς ἁμαρτήσαντος τὸ δώρημα τὸ μὲν γὰρ κρίμα ἐξ ἑνὸς εἰς κατάκριμα τὸ δὲ χάρισμα ἐκ πολλῶν παραπτωμάτων εἰς δικαίωμα

passages.text: For if, by the trespass of the one man, death reigned through that one man, how much more will those who receive an abundance of grace and of the gift of righteousness reign in life through the one man, Jesus Christ!
passages.sermon:
Adam was one man.
Adam committed a trespass.
Because of Adam’s trespass, death ruled over people.
Death ruled through Adam.
Jesus Christ is one man.
God gives grace through Jesus Christ.
God gives the gift of righteousness through Jesus Christ.
Some people receive much grace and the gift of righteousness.
Those who receive this grace and gift will rule in life.
They will rule in life through Jesus Christ.
passages.original: εἰ γὰρ τῷ τοῦ ἑνὸς παραπτώματι ὁ θάνατος ἐβασίλευσεν διὰ τοῦ ἑνός πολλῷ μᾶλλον οἱ τὴν περισσείαν τῆς χάριτος καὶ τῆς δωρεᾶς τῆς δικαιοσύνης λαμβάνοντες ἐν ζωῇ βασιλεύσουσιν διὰ τοῦ ἑνὸς Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ

passages.text: So then, just as one trespass brought condemnation for all men, so also one act of righteousness brought justification and life for all men.
passages.sermon:
Adam committed one sin.
This one sin brought condemnation to all people.
Jesus Christ performed one act of righteousness.
This one act brought justification and life to all people.
passages.original: Ἄρα οὖν ὡς δι’ ἑνὸς παραπτώματος εἰς πάντας ἀνθρώπους εἰς κατάκριμα οὕτως καὶ δι’ ἑνὸς δικαιώματος εἰς πάντας ἀνθρώπους εἰς δικαίωσιν ζωῆς

passages.text: For just as through the disobedience of the one man the many were made sinners, so also through the obedience of the one man the many will be made righteous.
passages.sermon:
Adam was one man.
Adam disobeyed God.
Because Adam disobeyed, many people became sinners.
Jesus is one man.
Jesus obeyed God.
Because Jesus obeyed, many people will become righteous.
passages.original: ὥσπερ γὰρ διὰ τῆς παρακοῆς τοῦ ἑνὸς ἀνθρώπου ἁμαρτωλοὶ κατεστάθησαν οἱ πολλοί οὕτως καὶ διὰ τῆς ὑπακοῆς τοῦ ἑνὸς δίκαιοι κατασταθήσονται οἱ πολλοί

passages.text: The law came in so that the trespass would increase; but where sin increased, grace increased all the more, so that, just as sin reigned in death, so also grace might reign through righteousness to bring eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.
passages.sermon:
God gave the law.
God gave the law so that people would see more of their sin.
Sin increased because of the law.
But grace increased even more than sin.
Sin ruled over people and brought death.
Grace now rules through righteousness.
Grace brings eternal life.
Jesus Christ is our Lord.
God gives eternal life through Jesus Christ.
passages.original: Νόμος δὲ παρεισῆλθεν ἵνα πλεονάσῃ τὸ παράπτωμα οὗ δὲ ἐπλεόνασεν ἡ ἁμαρτία ὑπερεπερίσσευσεν ἡ χάρις ἵνα ὥσπερ ἐβασίλευσεν ἡ ἁμαρτία ἐν τῷ θανάτῳ οὕτως καὶ ἡ χάρις βασιλεύσῃ διὰ δικαιοσύνης εἰς ζωὴν αἰώνιον διὰ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ τοῦ Κυρίου ἡμῶν
